title: Report accuracy by skill
statement: Report how students do skill by skill, on items that need the text.
example: An average over easy items hid three skills below 50%.
detail:
On the course the reading project set out to improve, students' accuracy on its three weakest skills was 39%, 42% and
48% (compare and contrast, cause and effect, sequence)
(`grade3-reading/artifacts/GOAL_grade3_hootl_convergence_2026_06_15.md`), while the usual 83% figure was an average
over the course's easy items, the wrong instrument (`grade3-reading/NORTH_STAR.md`).
against:
the true baseline is
unknown, and nothing here re-measured it (the same file).

The output of a diagnostic should be a per-KC probability of mastery (or a categorical estimate: "likely mastered / uncertain / likely not mastered"), not an aggregate score.
An unassessed KC is not the same as a failed KC, and conflating the two is one of the most common errors in diagnostic systems.
**Look at which dimensions failed, not just whether it passed.**
